observations.title: Measured-pass offline GitHub corpus snapshot
observations.אדון_הכל: GUI, CLI and evidence expose the same snapshot.
observations.הבט: The pinned fixture pack contains three acquired project records.
observations.הבן: This is measured offline evidence, not a live GitHub view.
observations.חקור: Acquisition is complete; fixture, request and evidence content identities are pinned.
observations.ראה: The snapshot resolves to one immutable offline authority.

observations.title: Canonical projects and extracted candidate declarations
observations.אדון_הכל: The Atlas projects counts, gaps and provenance.
observations.הבט: Three canonical projects form three groups and two candidate declarations.
observations.הבן: Counts are measured; open distinctions stay open.
observations.חקור: Normalization a33cfe69ae715a984b09ae240c880ebeaf34b8691f8a559667fd5bec03a4b9eb records six open distinctions.
observations.ראה: Relationships are canonicalized without approximate merging or ranking.

observations.title: Accepted unseen holdout generated without compiler changes
observations.אדון_הכל: CLI and GUI project the same outcome.
observations.הבט: The accepted holdout generated two byte-identical trees.
observations.הבן: This proves one supported unseen example, not arbitrary applications.
observations.חקור: Evaluation is generated-and-measured-pass; compiler identity stayed unchanged.
observations.ראה: Candidate and seed identities stay pinned to project 995929651.

observations.title: Unsupported holdout remains an explicit Standard Ten gap
observations.אדון_הכל: The Atlas displays the open outcome.
observations.הבט: Project 609855380 produced no accepted artifact.
observations.הבן: Support requires a separately authorized language change.
observations.חקור: Evaluation is standard.gap; no handwritten manual substitute was used.
observations.ראה: Unsupported stays distinct from measured-pass.

observations.title: Broader corpus coverage may expose new reusable distinctions
observations.אדון_הכל: The Atlas labels this as hypothesis.
observations.הבט: No broader measured-pass corpus is present.
observations.הבן: More pinned holdouts are required.
observations.חקור: Current fixtures cannot establish prevalence or universal coverage.
observations.ראה: Hypothesis stays separate from measured counts.

observations.title: Implement the read-only live GitHub corpus adapter
observations.אדון_הכל: The queue links without acquiring.
observations.הבט: Issue #43 exists; no live adapter exists here.
observations.הבן: Contributors can implement the explicit boundary independently.
observations.חקור: No network request is executed by this application.
observations.ראה: Live acquisition remains outside the offline Atlas.

observations.title: Evaluate additional independently pinned application groups
observations.אדון_הכל: The queue exposes the next evidence task.
observations.הבט: The research issue is open.
observations.הבן: Add pinned evidence without inference or approximate merging.
observations.חקור: No result is counted before evidence exists.
observations.ראה: Future holdouts preserve all identities.
